signals.name: Availability delta
signals.construction: Per club, per position group: sum of weight x status multiplier over official Week-10 rows.
signals.direction: Club with larger defensive-side loss concedes more points
signals.gate: G-03 calibration pending; publishable as DERIVED

signals.name: QB absence cascade
signals.construction: Starter-QB Out shifts that club's expected points by A-04 QB weight and its opponent's by the same amount, once only.
signals.input: SRC-02; starter identity from SRC-07 news where available
signals.target: spread, team total, all QB props for that game
signals.direction: Absence moves line against the club
signals.status: Computed for SEA (Darnold Out, Lock starts per SRC-07); blank for BAL (starter unidentifiable, FLG-06)

signals.name: Practice trajectory
signals.construction: Direction of practice participation across the Wed/Thu/Fri reports (FP to LP to DNP) rather than a single day's value.
signals.input: requires repeated snapshots of SRC-02 - not yet stored
signals.target: probability a Questionable player suits up
signals.direction: downgrading trajectory implies lower play probability
signals.status: NOT COMPUTED - one day of data exists

signals.name: Designation base rates
signals.construction: Historic play rate by designation, per position and per rest-day context, used to replace A-03.
signals.input: needs >=2 seasons of archived reports + inactives

signals.name: Planned-absence filter
signals.construction: Rows whose injury field reads 'Not injury related' (rest, personal matter) are excluded from injury-risk features but kept in availability.

signals.name: Secondary depletion
signals.construction: Count of CB+S rows with Out/Doubtful for a club's opponent-facing defense.
signals.target: opponent WR/TE reception and receiving-yard props
signals.direction: more backups -> more target volume for the other side

signals.name: Interior pass-rush depletion
signals.construction: Count of DT/DE Out or Doubtful.
signals.target: opponent pass-protection, QB sack props, run-block win rate proxy
signals.direction: less pressure -> higher opponent pass volume

signals.name: Offensive-line depletion
signals.construction: Count of T/G/C Out or Doubtful.
signals.direction: more line absences -> worse rush, more sacks

signals.name: Target vacancy
signals.construction: WR1/TE1 availability loss -> next-man usage shift.
signals.input: SRC-02 for loss; usage/snap-share data for the shift - absent from repo
signals.direction: vacancy raises the replacement's floor, not necessarily the team's ceiling

signals.name: Scoring-baseline totals
signals.construction: Expected total from per-game scoring and allowance, shrunk to the league mean (A-05).
signals.gate: G-04 needs a price to be scored against

signals.name: Record-versus-point-differential residual
signals.construction: Residual of W-L% after regressing on net points per game (league-wide r = +{{R_NET}} on 32 clubs).
signals.target: identify over/under-achieving clubs before prices adjust
signals.direction: positive residual = winning on luck, mean-reverts
signals.status: Computed (see correlation page); not tradable without prices

signals.name: Home/road asymmetry
signals.construction: Club's home win% minus road win%; league-wide home-vs-road win% correlation is only +{{R_HR}}, so split-based HFA estimates are noisy per club.
signals.status: Correlation computed; per-club HFA needs game logs (S-07)

strategies.name: QB-Out Fade
strategies.construction: When the official report marks a club's starting QB Out, take the opponent on the spread; one bet per game, no averaging across positions.
strategies.notes: Week 10 case study: SEA at LV (Darnold Out, Lock starts - SRC-07).

strategies.name: Secondary-Depletion Overs
strategies.construction: Opponent WR1 receiving yards over when the defense faces >=2 CB/S Out.
strategies.notes: Signal computed for 6 games in Week 10; effect size unknown.

strategies.name: OffLine Ruin Unders
strategies.construction: Club with >=2 T/G/C Out: team total under, provided no QB-Injury offset.
strategies.notes: Week 10 candidates: IND (4 OL rows), MIN, DAL, HOU - see deficiency table.

strategies.name: Same-game prop pair
strategies.construction: Team rush-yards under + team sack-taken over, priced by the same book on the same slate; only if measured |r| < 0.30 cap or the book's joint price is beaten after haircut.
strategies.notes: Correlation matrix does not exist yet; the only pilot (n=16 games) is in a legacy tree and is below the sample gate.

strategies.name: 3-Leg Parlay Discipline
strategies.construction: Max 3 legs, no two legs from the same game unless the joint price is verified, and never more than one injury-leg per club.
strategies.notes: Explicitly a loss-limitation rule, not an edge.

strategies.name: Residual Fader
strategies.construction: Fade the club with the largest positive W-L% residual over net points per game once prices imply a materially smaller edge.
strategies.notes: Directly uses SIG-11; the four computed correlations are the only evidence and they are descriptive, 32 team-seasons.

strategies.name: Neutral-Site Correction
strategies.construction: Where the slate marks an international/neutral venue (Munich: NE at DET), remove HFA from the originated line and take the side the raw model favours only if the delta exceeds a stated threshold.
strategies.notes: Parameter A-02 is itself an assumption (FLG-12).

strategies.name: Availability Composite
strategies.construction: Rank games by the gap between the originated line and the closing line; bet only the tails, sized by the published uncertainty.
strategies.notes: This is the strategy the whole pipeline exists to test; it cannot run today.

gates.name: Provenance
gates.requirement: Every input row carries a source URL and an as-of timestamp; unknown values are blank, never imputed.
gates.threshold: 100% of rows; enforced by scripts/check_hub.py at build
gates.status: PASSED for the hub's own tables
gates.why: One unlabelled fetch makes the whole backtest unreproducible

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.requirement: Strategy spec, parameters, entry/exit and staking rule committed and hash-stamped before any graded outcome is recorded.
gates.threshold: git commit + sha256 of the spec file recorded in the row
gates.why: Anything tuned after seeing results is hindsight

gates.name: Sample size
gates.requirement: Minimum graded bets, weeks and seasons before a strategy is ranked.
gates.threshold: >=200 bets, >=40 distinct game-weeks, >=2 seasons (convention, not a league rule)
gates.why: Small samples are variance wearing a costume

gates.name: Calibration
gates.requirement: Model parameters fitted on data the strategy is not scored on, with a held-out year.
gates.threshold: no shared season between fit and test; reported fit error
gates.status: NOT MET (all parameters are assumptions, FLG-12)
gates.why: Uncalibrated weights just encode the author's priors

gates.name: Cost-aware pricing
gates.requirement: Grading uses real captured prices including vig, at a stated capture time.
gates.threshold: median |model - close| and CLV computed on >=200 bets
gates.status: IMPOSSIBLE TODAY - no verified price source (FLG-07)
gates.why: Beating a midpoint is not beating a market

gates.name: Uncertainty reporting
gates.requirement: Every published performance figure carries an interval and a max-drawdown; no bare point estimates.
gates.threshold: bootstrap 95% CI over bets, clustered by game-week
gates.why: A number without error bars is an invitation to overbet

gates.name: Overfitting test
gates.requirement: Probability of backtest overfitting estimated by CSCV across the parameter grid actually searched.
gates.why: The best in-sample setting is usually the most overfit one (SRC-11)

gates.name: Selection-bias correction
gates.requirement: Deflated Sharpe ratio accounting for the number of variants tried, skew and kurtosis of returns.
gates.why: Trials you discarded still inflate the survivor's score (SRC-10)

gates.name: Robustness
gates.requirement: Performance survives subset and leave-out tests: home/away, rest days, division, removing the best 5% of bets.
gates.threshold: sign of edge preserved in >=80% of subsets
gates.why: Three lucky weeks can carry a whole backtest

gates.name: Correlation and exposure
gates.requirement: Leg-correlation matrix measured; per-game and per-club caps enforced; parlays priced jointly not multiplied.
gates.threshold: max |r| per parlay 0.30 until validated; single-club exposure cap stated in Q-10
gates.status: NOT MET (no matrix beyond an n=16 pilot)
gates.why: Correlation is how two edges become one bet

gates.name: Paper-trade gate
gates.requirement: After all above: a forward, untouched period run at the stated staking rule before any reward consideration.
gates.threshold: >=4 weeks of forward results, published before review
gates.why: The only test that cannot be gamed is the one you have not seen yet

correlation_register.pair: Points for per game vs win percentage
correlation_register.method: Pearson r on the official 2026 standings snapshot of 2026-11-14

correlation_register.pair: Points against per game vs win percentage
Net points per game vs win percentage
correlation_register.caveat: mechanically high: net points embed wins; useful as a luck-residual base, not as a signal

correlation_register.pair: Home win percentage vs road win percentage
correlation_register.caveat: weak: split-based home/road talent estimates are noisy at 8-9 games

correlation_register.pair: Net points per game vs points for per game
correlation_register.caveat: published deliberately: shows how a derived quantity re-uses its own inputs

correlation_register.pair: Total points scored by both clubs vs absolute margin
correlation_register.status: COMPUTED (this session, from the in-repo 2026 game log)
correlation_register.method: Pearson r over every final 2026 score in data/desk/games.json (SRC-17), recomputed here rather than copied
correlation_register.caveat: the desk unit publishes -0.161 for this pair; recomputation shows -0.161 is r against the SIGNED margin while r against |margin| is -0.016, i.e. no blowout relationship in this sample (FLG-22)

correlation_register.pair: Rushing yards vs game total (same club)
correlation_register.method: needs play-by-play or box-score ingestion (the in-repo game log is score-only)
correlation_register.caveat: needed before any run-pass parlay is allowed

correlation_register.pair: QB passing yards vs WR1 receiving yards
correlation_register.caveat: the core combo correlation; blocked by Q-12 and S-04

correlation_register.method: injury rows joined to defensive box scores
correlation_register.caveat: input availability measured, outcome data absent

correlation_register.pair: Injury designation change vs line movement
correlation_register.method: snapshot diff of SRC-02 against price moves
correlation_register.caveat: impossible until S-04 and S-05 both exist

correlation_register.method: autocorrelation of model-minus-close; blocked with G-04 (no prices), not blocked by game data
correlation_register.caveat: the honest test of whether the model has any persistence

correlation_register.method: cross-game: same-club legs and divisional opponents
correlation_register.caveat: required by G-09 before parlays across games are allowed

correlation_register.pair: away score vs home score (same game)
correlation_register.method: Pearson r over the same 137 finals
correlation_register.caveat: reproduces the desk unit's figure exactly; near zero, so game-level scores are close to independent - relevant to cross-game parlay legs

score_model: primary: median closing-line value per bet, with a bootstrap 95% interval clustered by game-week
secondary: ROI at the stated vig, same interval treatment
qualification: DSR > 0 (SRC-10) and PBO < 0.5 (SRC-11) on the grid that was actually searched
display: never rank on a bare point estimate; an entry with an interval that spans zero is shown as undetermined
season_structure: Review: promote, park or ban with reasons published
anti_gaming: One leaderboard entry per spec; a variant that changes a parameter is a new entry and increases the trial count used in DSR
Disclose every variant tried, including discarded ones
No near-duplicate entries (same family, same construction, different threshold)
Retire an entry that misses its own stated threshold after the review period, publicly

rewards.basis: Reward value, payout mechanism and legality are unanswered (Q-08, FLG-14); the design specifies tiers only

tiers.criteria: all gates passed, top 3 by CLV lower bound

leaderboard.entries_note: Empty by design: {{GATES_FAILED}} of {{GATES_TOTAL}} blocking gates are unpassed and no graded bet exists anywhere in the repository.

luck_controls: Separate variance from skill by measuring against prices, not outcomes alone (G-04, G-05).
Correct for the trials you ran, not just the strategy you kept (G-06, G-07).
Require out-of-sample and leave-best-out tests before promotion (G-08, G-10).
Cap the things that make luck look like skill: correlated legs, small samples, post-hoc thresholds (G-01, G-09).
Publish the residual of W-L% over net points as a luck index for clubs, and treat its mean reversion as the hypothesis (SIG-11).
